content.text:
users are getting confused when running the v2 checkpoints migration command because v1 used to push the checkpoints to a branch whereas now it's a custom refspec that isn't visible in the GitHub UI.

the migration command, when complete, should notify the user of these changes and that they may see the v2 checkpoints locally via git ls-remote origin 'refs/entire/checkpoints/v2/*' or by visiting the details of a checkpoint in entire.io and clicking the "session logs" link.

I’ll trace the migration command’s completion path first, then patch the user-facing message where it naturally belongs. I’m also checking the worktree state up front so I don’t step on anything already in progress.

The repo has a lot of checkpoint-related text, so I’m narrowing this to the actual `migrate --checkpoints v2` implementation and its tests. I see only untracked files so far, which I’ll leave untouched.

input.cmd: rg -n "migrate --checkpoints|Migrate|migrateCheckpoints|checkpoints v2|Migration complete|Nothing to migrate|already migrated|--checkpoints" cmd/entire/cli -g '*.go'
rg -n "Migration complete|Nothing to migrate|git ls-remote|session logs|checkpoints_version|refs/entire/checkpoints/v2" cmd/entire/cli docs -g '*.go' -g '*.md'

content.text: The completion summary is centralized in `cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go`, which is good: one small output change should cover normal migration, re-runs where everything is skipped, and forced re-migration. I’m checking how command-level output is tested so the wording gets pinned down.

I’m going to keep the migration logic itself untouched and add a small completion-message helper plus a focused unit test. The note will explicitly call out the custom refs, the GitHub UI difference, the `git ls-remote` command, and the entire.io “session logs” path.

+func printMigrateCheckpointsV2Completion(out io.Writer, result *migrateResult) {
+	fmt.Fprintf(out, "\nMigration complete: %d migrated, %d skipped, %d failed\n",
+		result.migrated, result.skipped, result.failed)
+	fmt.Fprintln(out, "V2 checkpoints are stored as custom refs under refs/entire/checkpoints/v2/*, not as a branch visible in the GitHub UI.")
+	fmt.Fprintf(out, "To inspect pushed v2 checkpoint refs locally, run: git ls-remote %s 'refs/entire/checkpoints/v2/*'\n", migrateRemoteName)
+	fmt.Fprintln(out, `You can also open a checkpoint's details in entire.io and click the "session logs" link.`)
+}
+
 var (
 	errAlreadyMigrated          = errors.New("already migrated")
 	errTranscriptNotGeneratable = errors.New("transcript.jsonl could not be generated")
 )
*** End Patch

+	assert.Contains(t, output, `click the "session logs" link`)
